summary.text: Bangladesh U19 scored 303-8 in their innings, with Ahsan Al Mumin as the top scorer with 152 off 133 balls while Aulga Gunawan took 2 for 48. MLYU19 were bowled out for 98-10 as N Sathnakumaran scored 50 off 81 balls and Tafiul Alam Tamim took 7 for 18. Bangladesh U19 won the match by 205 runs.
